info.name: Moodle Talk Bridge
info.summary: Create and sync Nextcloud Talk rooms from Moodle course activities
info.description:
Companion app for the Moodle **Nextcloud Talk Session** activity (`mod_nextcloudtalk`). It lets a Moodle course create a Talk room and drop teachers and students straight into it, without them needing separate Nextcloud credentials.
**What it does**
- Receives HMAC-signed webhooks from Moodle and creates, updates or archives the matching Talk conversation. - Provisions Nextcloud accounts for Moodle participants on first use and keeps the room roster in sync with course enrolment. - Grants Moodle teachers moderator rights in the Talk room; students join as regular participants. - Provides a signed single-use ticket endpoint so a user clicking the activity link in Moodle lands in the conversation already signed in. - Exposes a health endpoint backing the "Test connection" button on the Moodle side.
**Requirements**
- **Nextcloud Talk (spreed) must be installed and enabled** — this app drives it and does nothing on its own. - A dedicated bot account with an app password, plus the shared secret agreed with the Moodle instance.
Configuration is applied with `occ config:app:set moodle_talk_bridge …`; there is no admin UI yet. See the README for the full list of keys.
**Getting the Moodle plugin**
This app is only the Nextcloud half of the integration. The companion Moodle activity plugin (`mod_nextcloudtalk`) is supplied directly by Brain Station 23 rather than through the Moodle plugins directory. To request the plugin, or for installation and support enquiries, contact **elearning@brainstation-23.com**.
